## 10.MasterEquipment List:

- a)Include a master cquipment list in themanuals which shall detail all items ofequipmentwhichareinstalledinthePermanentWorks.Providethelist in a format approved by the Contract Administrator and/or the Supervision Consultant. The inforrmation required for each item on the list shall be as follows:
- i. Tag Number.
- iii. Installed Locatior.
- i.Description/Nomenclature: Descriptive data such as dimensions and operating parameters shall be included where appropriate.
- iv.Applicable Specification Section/Paragraph Reference.
- V. Name, Address and other contact information of Manufacturer (Supplier).
- vi. Model,Serial Number and Other Identification:Contractorshallenter informationrequired topositivelyidentify the equipment.
- vii. Remarks:Contractor shall enter the manner in which any standard catalogueornormaldeliveryitemhasbeenmodifiedorisunique.
- vili. Extended warranty, if applicable by Contract requirements, and warrantyexpirationdate.

- 12.Guarantees and Warranties:Include original copies of specified guarantees and warrantiesand standardguarantees andwarrantiesprovidedby addressed to theEmployer.

1. Provide extra stock as required by various Sections of the Specification in MATERlALS, and hand over to Employer twenty-one (21) days prior to Contractor's request for inspection for the Taking Over of the Works.

Tag number.
